aaf5aff0.text:
You dial yourself up every morning.

The switch says: what is that hum?

I’m calling for myself. The humming is not my own,

b8d163bb.text: it's the humming of someone else.

39dee085.text: I can't help it, I’m going to the end of my rope.

88573568.text: And if the phone keeps ringing

f6842b78.text: I'll just have to turn off the machine.

567e8205.text: You say you're tired, tired of talking

081d3fbd.text: I don't have the time or energy. You tell me the time,

9dac1d66.text: you say, and I look at your watch and read the time.

f908b166.text: You say it's your fault, your fault for calling me.

e33330c8.text: I've been thinking about you, but it isn't me

e23717c7.text: It's someone else's fault. It's not your fault. It isn't mine.

af900545.text: We talk on the telephone. We're all alone.

249019f1.text: We're all alone, we're all alone

a0f578f3.text: we're all alone when we talk on the telephone

548801e1.text: The switch says: what is that sound?

215a3d52.text: What's that noise? What is it?

620fc2c3.text: The machine doesn't know what to do, it can't help

1be09f39.text: I'm calling for myself. I need the machine.

fadbfb3c.text: The phone is silent, we are alone in our own heads.

e947e64e.text: we are alone in our own heads

19a7fc02.text: and we think the same things

220a1557.text: we're alone in our own minds
